product_one_liner.value: koppla provides collaborative construction scheduling and project-control software for general contractors, general planners, developers and architects.

pricing_page.notes: Publishes project and enterprise licensing plans; prices are supplied by individual quotation.

employee_band.notes: The company about page reports 38 employees.

hq_location.notes: The legal address and PitchBook headquarters listing identify Potsdam; some professional profiles instead list Berlin.

eng_blog.notes: The blog covers construction methods, scheduling and product features, rather than multiple engineer-authored posts about building the software.

public_docs.notes: Public help center has multiple topic collections and product-support articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable board lists Engineering Manager, Product Engineer - Frontend, Product Engineer, Account Executive and Sales Development Representative; none meets the specified AI/ML/data-science title test.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or provider was identified in the reviewed AI page, help materials, blog or Trust Center. The Trust Center lists a data-processing agreement but does not publicly identify an AI subprocessor.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR under Compliance. GDPR is a regulatory-compliance claim, not itself a certification.

last_funding.notes: The investor announcement dates the €6 million round to May 19, 2025; CB Insights labels it Seed VC - III and reports $6.76 million. This primary announcement takes precedence over conflicting June dates in other profiles.

raised_18mo.notes: The May 19, 2025 funding announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company job board lists both (Senior) Account Executive and Sales Development Representative / SDR openings; the recruiting post also advertises the Account Executive vacancy.

launched_6mo.notes: A May 27, 2026 announcement introduces the new BIM integration, linking scheduling with 4D BIM; this falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Fabian Schaeffer’s published CV dates his VP Revenue tenure at koppla September 2025–October 2026, indicating departure within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window. His LinkedIn profile still lists the role as current, so the sources conflict.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company BDR job description explicitly names these sales tools. That particular archived vacancy is no longer accepting applications; it is evidence of the stack, not current hiring.
